text: Van Inwagen's own answer to the Special Composition Question is that composition occurs if and only if the activity of the objects constitutes a life, so that the only composite objects are living organisms.
explanation: True. Van Inwagen's organicism restricts composition to cases where the xs' activity constitutes a life; on his view there are living organisms and simples, but tables and other artifacts are not genuine composite objects. This is his restricted 'middle' answer, positioned between nihilism and universalism.
